facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Default keyboard controls reported by BloxInformer: WASD to move, E to open the stats upgrade menu, and Q to open the tank upgrade menu.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: New tanks get a short spawn-immunity window so they can shoot food and start building before other players can fight them.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: The first tank-class upgrade becomes available at level 15 through the Q menu. BloxInformer lists Double, Scout, Spammer, Side, Grinder, and Freezer as level-15 options, with Flame listed as available to 7x3 group members.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Further tank-class upgrades appear around every 15 levels and often require a specific prior path. BloxInformer says tanks at level 60 and above must first be unlocked in the lobby Tanks Shop using Diamonds earned from play.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: BloxInformer's beginner guide recommends putting early stat points into bullet damage and bullet health so shots can pierce weaker enemy bullets after spawn immunity ends, then investing in max HP or HP regen.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Beebom describes the start as spawning as a small circular tank with a single turret, then shooting colorful cubes and other shapes for XP. Later upgrades can add turrets or change shots to flame or freeze.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Sportskeeda reports that Diamonds (also called gems in the official description and most code lists) are the primary shop currency. They buy tank unlocks in the Tank Shop and raise per-stat capacity. The same page says each attribute starts with a 7-point cap that gems can raise.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: Promo codes are redeemed in-game through a blue tick or checkmark icon on the left side of the screen. Players type or paste the code and press Redeem. Pocket Tactics, Destructoid, and Sportskeeda agree on a left-side codes control.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: Destructoid's 2026-08-17 steps: run the game, press the codes button on the left, type into the text box, hit Redeem.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: GamesRadar and Sportskeeda both report that Tank Game codes are not case-sensitive. Sportskeeda also shows an already-redeemed error: each working code can be claimed only once per account.

facts.subject: mistake
facts.claim: GamesRadar warns that the game does not pause while the codes menu is open. Unless the player is in the lobby, other tanks can still shoot them during redemption.

first_10_minutes: Join Tank Game by 7x3 at place 119789365111500. The live listing name is 💥 Tank Game! [2.4].
If a lobby exists, open the blue tick / checkmark on the left and redeem the four codes currently printed on the official Roblox page: REBALANCEAGAIN, HAVEFUN, NEWCURRENCY, HEADSTART.
Do not open the codes menu in a live fight; secondary guides say the game does not pause.
On spawn you have a short immunity window. Use WASD, shoot food shapes (squares, triangles, pentagons) for XP.
Treat 'destroy 100 squares / triangles / pentagons' as the first badge-sized goals.
Press E and spend the first stat points on bullet damage and bullet health, then HP or regen.
At level 15, press Q and pick a first class. BloxInformer lists Double, Scout, Spammer, Side, Grinder, and Freezer; Flame is reported as a 7x3 group option.
Optional: join group 111185671 before that first Q pick if you want the reported Flame / group perk.
After immunity, avoid idle farming in contested mid-map until your bullets can win trades.
Destroy other tanks when safe; official copy says that is how you earn gems.
Ignore offsale hello game pass and any old Titan-price rumors; the catalog showed no priced pass.
If you die often, reset in a quieter area and rebuild during the next immunity window rather than forcing 1v1s.
core_loop: Shoot food shapes to gain XP and levels.
Spend a stat point each level in the E menu (damage, health, speed, fire rate, bullet health, regen, body damage, and related stats).
At class-upgrade levels (about every 15 levels, starting at 15), press Q to evolve along a path.
Use the in-game Index to see legal paths instead of memorizing blog trees.
Destroy other tanks to earn gems / diamonds.
Spend gems in the Tanks Shop and on raising stat caps.
Optional: join 7x3 for reported exclusive tanks such as Flame.
Redeem official page codes in the lobby for XP and gems.
Repeat lives are expected; average sessions on trackers are short.
Badge hunts (100 / 10,000 of each shape) give long-term PvE goals beside PVP.
progression_path: Level 0–14: farm food under spawn immunity, stack bullet damage and bullet health, then HP or regen.
Level 15: first class via Q. This choice feeds later branches.
Levels ~30 and ~42: next class upgrades on the same path.
Spend gems to raise the per-stat cap (Sportskeeda said the start cap is 7; confirm in 2.4) and to unlock shop tanks.
Level 60+: BloxInformer says shop unlocks are required before some classes. Check the lobby Tanks Shop.
Later gates reported around 80 (Mega Freezer), 90, 105 (Railgun), 130, and 150 (Orchestra, Double Railgun, Orbitron Sr.). Confirm in the Index.
Ranged builds (Destructoid): Damage and Fire Rate; Rail also wants Penetration and Laser Range.
Melee builds: Health, Body Damage, and Speed.
Group tank: Flame, if still a 7x3 unlock at the first class choice.
Shop tank example: Mega Freezer, described as a diamond-shop close-range option.
Version 2.4 rebalance (REBALANCEAGAIN) may have moved older tier-list winners; prefer current Index + live feel.
Extra places named STARTER / PRO / MEGA / TRADING / Red VS Blue exist on trackers; pick them only after you know what they are.
common_mistakes: Opening the codes UI in a live arena instead of the lobby.
Typing expired, mistyped, or already-redeemed codes. ALLCODESASPROMISE without the last D is a known near-miss.
Ignoring bullet health: after spawn immunity, weaker bullets lose the trade.
Picking omnidirectional (side/back barrel) tanks if the goal is 1v1 PVP.
Treating third-party tank trees as complete; BloxInformer comments already dispute its tables.
Using exploits; official page says exploiting bans are permanent and unappealable.
Confusing this 7x3 game with Tank Simulator or Tank Game Simulator.
Publishing Destructoid/PGG's 30+ code dump as the official working list.
Inventing gem prices, XP curves, or a full skill tree.
Assuming there is a priced VIP pass; the catalog showed only offsale hello.
Rushing the first Q upgrade before you know whether you want frontal DPS or farm-oriented barrels.
faq: Who made Tank Game? Verified Roblox group 7x3 (id 111185671), owned by supportTheBlueFan.
How do I level up? Shoot food shapes for XP, spend points with E, evolve with Q.
How do I get gems? Official text: destroy tanks and earn gems. Codes also grant gems or XP.
Which codes are confirmed on the official page today? REBALANCEAGAIN, HAVEFUN, NEWCURRENCY, HEADSTART.
How do I redeem codes? Blue tick/checkmark on the left, enter the code, Redeem. Reported not case-sensitive and one-time.
What food exists? Badges name squares, triangles, and pentagons.
When is the first tank class? Level 15 via Q.
Is there a Discord? Guides cite https://discord.com/invite/WgCdbaMrrq.
Are gems and diamonds the same? Official copy says gems; some wikis say Diamonds. Not proven as two currencies.
Are there paid gamepasses? Public catalog showed only an offsale pass named hello.
How many unique tanks? Official description says over 150+.
Is the Fandom wiki official? It has described itself as unofficial until BlueFan approves it.
What is version 2.4? The live display-name tag at this check, last API update 2026-08-17.

uncertainties: Secondary code lists disagree. Official page lists only four strings. Destructoid/PGG/Dexerto still publish many older codes that were not printed on the official page at this check. No in-game redemption check was run.
Official text uses gems; BloxInformer and Sportskeeda often say Diamonds. Not proven whether they are one currency or two.
Starting per-stat cap of 7 is Sportskeeda-only and may have changed in 2.4.
BloxInformer / Fandom / SportsRant tank trees are incomplete or contested. Destructoid removed its path section because an in-game Index exists.
Exact spawn-immunity duration, food XP values, level curve, and full E-menu names/caps were not confirmed on an official page.
No priced gamepasses were listed. Older Titan / P2W mentions are unverified.
Rolimon's extra places exist as names, but queue rules and which one new players should pick were not documented.
Fandom wiki was only partially readable (Cloudflare) and has called itself unofficial.
Exact in-game reward for joining 7x3 is not specified beyond group 'perks' plus secondary Flame reports.
Live CCU, visits, likes, favorites, and Rolimon's playtime/peak figures change constantly.
forbidden_claims: Do not treat Tank Simulator or Tank Game Simulator as this game.
Do not publish a canonical currently-working codes list beyond the four official description strings without a fresh in-game check.
Do not present the Fandom wiki as developer-approved.
Do not treat BloxInformer's full tank table as complete or current.
Do not invent gem/diamond prices, XP tables, or a full skill tree.
Do not present live CCU, visits, likes, or favorites as evergreen facts.
Do not claim on-sale gamepasses or a priced Titan pass; the public catalog showed only an offsale hello pass.
Do not claim exploiting bans can be appealed.
Do not copy long passages from Roblox or third-party guides into site copy.
